description: When consent is the lawful basis for processing, no valid mechanism exists to obtain, record, or verify consent that meets GDPR requirements for being freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous.
applicability: Applicable where consent is used as the lawful basis for processing. Includes consent collection interfaces, preference centers, and consent management platforms.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of consent collection mechanisms, consent records, and user interfaces. Assess whether consent meets all GDPR validity requirements.
